description: Conectividad Digital del Departamento del Caquetá is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Caquetá, Caquetá. Información unificada sobre Estaciones Terrenas, Fibra Óptica, Ecosistemas de Innovación, Formación Digital, Radio FM/AM, Red de Alta Velocidad, TDT y juntas de internet internet implementadas en el Departamento del Caquetá. Coverage: Gobernación de Caquetá, Caquetá. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Caquetá, Caquetá. Its tags are internet, formación, telecomunicaciones, televisión, conectividad. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
